regime_context: The policy regime is low-real-yield engineering (Fed framework reset, Treasury yield suppression) paired with strategic reindustrialization. The stagflationary split—hot PCE, weak payrolls, oil spike from Iran—creates a consensus narrative of stagflation that is bearish for risk assets, but revealed policy intent favors holding front-end rates steady while structurally suppressing longer yields, which disproportionately supports strategic sectors (defense, domestic semis, nuclear) over broad market.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制为低实际收益率工程（美联储框架重设、财政部收益率抑制）与战略再工业化并行。滞胀分裂——PCE升温、就业疲软、伊朗导致的油价飙升——形成了市场对滞胀看空风险资产的共识叙事，但显露的政策意图是保持前端利率稳定并结构性压低长端收益率，这使得战略板块（国防、本土半导体、核能）相较整体市场获得不成比例的支持。

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The 25% advanced-chip tariff remains in force and the pending Section 301 replacement (~12.5%) likely preserves protection for domestic fabs; the onshoring bid persists despite the China tariff truce because the de-risking mandate endures. Overweight SMH vs SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 25%先进芯片关税维持生效，待定的301条款替代方案（约12.5%）很可能为本土晶圆厂保留保护；尽管中美关税休战，去风险化要求持续存在，本土化投资逻辑依旧成立。相对SPY超配SMH。
evidence: China theater: tariff-protection premium persists, contingent on Section 301 handoff completing cleanly.
Open prediction: The 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force and/or covered list expands.
theses.dissent: A broader tariff truce could include removal or softening of chip tariffs, undermining the domestic semiconductor protection premium.
theses.dissent_zh: 更广泛的关税休战可能包含取消或放松芯片关税，削弱本土半导体保护溢价。

falsifier.text: The 25% advanced-chip tariff is rescinded or its covered list reduced before July 24.
falsifier.text_zh: 25%先进芯片关税在7月24日前被撤销，或其覆盖范围缩小。

theses.subject: XAR
theses.thesis: The Iran re-escalation (ceasefire collapse, US strikes) and the structural NATO spending super-cycle generate sustained demand for defense primes and missile-defense systems; this acts as a geopolitical hedge that benefits regardless of stagflationary pressures. Overweight XAR vs SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗冲突再升级（停火破裂、美军打击）加上北约结构性支出超级周期，对国防主承包商和导弹防御系统产生持续需求；这充当了地缘政治对冲，在滞胀压力下仍能获益。相对SPY超配XAR。
evidence: Iran theater: ceasefire collapsed 7/8, US strikes, Brent spiked ~$80, defense bid persists regardless.
theses.dissent: A renewed ceasefire or diplomatic resolution could rapidly unwind the defense premium and lead to underperformance.
theses.dissent_zh: 重新达成停火或外交解决可能迅速消除国防溢价，导致跑输大市。

falsifier.text: A new Iran ceasefire is announced and implemented, with US CENTCOM strike cadence dropping to near-zero for at least two consecutive weeks.
falsifier.text_zh: 宣布并实施新的伊朗停火，且美军中央司令部打击频率至少连续两周降至接近零。

check.note: graded via correlated surrogate XLI (no local series for XAR)

theses.subject: SMR
theses.thesis: The administration's nuclear-for-AI push, evidenced by planned DOE release of HALEU into the fuel bank, drives a structural shift favoring nuclear fuel cycle and small modular reactor developers. Overweight SMR vs SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 政府推动核能支持人工智能，计划由能源部向核燃料银行释放HALEU，这驱动了有利于核燃料循环和小型模块化反应堆开发商的结构性转变。相对SPY超配SMR。
evidence: Open prediction: DOE releases ≥20 MT HALEU into fuel bank for private/AI projects.
Rotation theme: Nuclear · uranium · HALEU/fuel cycle.
theses.dissent: HALEU supply may face permitting or production delays, and AI compute demand could taper, deflating the nuclear capex narrative.
theses.dissent_zh: HALEU供应可能面临审批或生产延迟，且人工智能计算需求可能回落，使核能资本支出叙事失去动力。

falsifier.text: The DOE fails to release any HALEU into the fuel bank for private/AI projects by end of Q3 2026 (Sept 30).
falsifier.text_zh: 能源部未在2026年第三季度末（9月30日）前向私营/人工智能项目释放任何HALEU至核燃料银行。
